name: 60620 · Chicago, IL
findings: ZIP 60620 (Chicago) has 333 nonprofit organizations. 107 of them (32%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 83 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (42% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 60620 (Chicago) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 84 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
